Actions.Text: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION

Title: Prohibits the importation and sale of certain household cleaning products that use animal testing
Summary: Prohibits manufacturers from importing and selling certain household cleaning products that use animal testing, if the animal testing was conducted on or after January first, two thousand twenty-eight.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to prohibiting the importation and sale of certain household cleaning products using animal testing
